site.name: fleetatlas
site.summary: FleetAtlas Fictional commercial fleet real-time management SaaS dashboard, used as a UXBench fixture. Pages - `index.html` — Fleet overview map home. Left thin rail nav; top bar with org switcher, view tabs (Map / List / Analytics), search box, alert bell (dropdown shows the 5 most recent on click); status filter strip (All / Running / Idle / Maintenance / Offline / Alert); full-screen SVG city map with 25 vehicles in real-time positions (running vehicles jitter their position every 5 seconds to simulate live updates); clicking a vehicle icon or drawer row → right detail panel slides in; bottom pull-up drawer showing the vehicle list. - Right detail panel (controlled by JS within the map page) — basic info (plate / model / year / VIN / fleet), driver info (with phone / shift / accumulated drive hours), current task (route / location / ETA / remaining miles), historical track SVG (24h / 7d / 30d toggle), fuel and speed sparklines; 4 action buttons (Send command / Contact driver / Maintenance record / Reassign task), with Reassign being a destructive action that has a second-confirmation modal. - `alerts.html` — Alerts center. 4 KPI cards (open / new today / by severity / mean handli

explored_user_goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full fleetatlas system, prioritizing the primary dashboard flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_summary: The FleetAtlas dashboard and adjacent pages (alerts, analytics, vehicles) have several UX issues. Key problems include mobile horizontal overflow, missing form labels, small tap targets, and inconsistent page loading. Many interactive features remain untested, and some controls failed to respond, indicating potential accessibility and usability gaps.

exploration_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of FleetAtlas, focusing on the primary dashboard flow, adjacent pages (alerts, analytics, vehicles), key interactions (vehicle details, alerts, analytics), and mobile responsiveness.
exploration_plan.summary: Start with the dashboard (index.html) to validate real-time updates, vehicle interactions, and detail panel actions. Then explore alerts.html, analytics.html, and vehicles.html, checking their unique features and interactions. Repeat critical checks on mobile viewport. Validate high-risk actions like reassigning tasks and alert handling.
assumptions: The site's JS functionality (e.g., real-time updates, detail panel sliding) works as described in the prescan.
risk_hotspots: index.html (real-time vehicle updates, reassign task confirmation)

phases.title: Dashboard (index.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate dashboard interactions, real-time updates, and detail panel actions.
key_checks: Check real-time vehicle position updates (wait 5 seconds for jitter)
Click a vehicle icon to open the detail panel
Interact with status filters (All, Running, etc.)
exit_criteria: All key dashboard interactions tested, real-time updates observed, detail panel and reassign task validated.

phases.title: Alerts Center (alerts.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate alert handling, KPI cards, and filtering.
key_checks: Check KPI cards (open, new today, etc.)
Filter alerts by severity, type, and status
exit_criteria: Alert filtering and actions validated, KPI cards reviewed.

phases.title: Analytics (analytics.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate analytics dashboard, KPI cards, and driver performance.
key_checks: Review KPI cards (total mileage, fuel economy, etc.)
exit_criteria: Analytics dashboard features validated, KPI cards and heatmap reviewed.

phases.title: Vehicles (vehicles.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate vehicle list, filtering, and details.
key_checks: Test vehicle list filtering (status, fleet, etc.)
Click a vehicle to view details
exit_criteria: Vehicle list filtering and details validated, search functionality tested.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Validate critical interactions on mobile viewport.
key_checks: Repeat critical checks (e.g., vehicle detail panel, alert filtering, analytics KPI cards) on mobile viewport
Check small tap targets identified in layout warnings
exit_criteria: Critical interactions validated on mobile, small tap targets reviewed.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 4 known HTML pages (index, alerts, analytics, vehicles).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise most visible controls (filters, buttons, search, detail panels) on each key page.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (dashboard interactions, alert handling, vehicle details) on mobile viewport.

notes: Pay attention to real-time updates on the dashboard. Validate confirmation modals for destructive actions (e.g., reassign task). Check layout warnings for small tap targets on mobile.

findings.user_goal: View and interact with the vehicle list on mobile
findings.problem: The vehicles.html page has horizontal overflow (page width 916px > viewport 390px) in mobile view, making off-screen table columns inaccessible.
findings.evidence: Observation shows page width 916px exceeds mobile viewport 390px, with visible text cut off horizontally.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t access all vehicle details without horizontal scrolling, reducing efficiency and increasing frustration.
findings.suggestion: Implement responsive table design (e.g., horizontal scrolling, column stacking) to fit mobile viewports.

findings.user_goal: Filter vehicles using dropdowns on mobile
findings.problem: Multiple form fields (select elements) in vehicles.html lack labels, aria-labels, or placeholders, reducing accessibility for screen reader users.
findings.evidence: DOM summary shows select elements with no labels, and layout warnings confirm missing input labels.
findings.why_it_matters: Screen reader users can’t identify filter purposes, leading to confusion and usability barriers.
findings.suggestion: Add visible labels or aria-labels to all form fields (e.g., 'Filter by status', 'Filter by fleet').

findings.user_goal: Interact with buttons and checkboxes on mobile
findings.problem: Small tap targets (e.g., 13x13px checkboxes, 36x36px '👤' button, 57x26px 'Details' buttons) in vehicles.html violate mobile tap target guidelines (minimum 44x44px).
findings.evidence: Layout warnings and visible text confirm tap targets below 44x44px, including checkboxes and buttons.
findings.why_it_matters: Users may accidentally tap wrong elements or struggle to interact, increasing error rates and frustration.
findings.suggestion: Increase tap target sizes (e.g., 44x44px for checkboxes, 44x44px for buttons) and adjust spacing.

findings.user_goal: Navigate to the Vehicles page via the bottom navigation tab
findings.problem: The 'Vehicles' bottom navigation tab (target_id ux-30) failed to respond to clicks in mobile view, with a timeout error.
findings.evidence: Failed click action log: 'Locator.click: Timeout 4000ms exceeded' for ux-30.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t navigate to the Vehicles page, blocking task completion and reducing trust in the interface.
findings.suggestion: Fix the click interaction for the 'Vehicles' tab, ensuring it’s accessible and responsive in mobile view.

findings.user_goal: Load and interact with alerts.html content
findings.problem: The alerts.html page frequently failed to load content (only sidebar visible) in desktop and mobile viewports, requiring multiple reloads.
findings.evidence: UX signals and observations show inconsistent loading, with empty main content areas and failed reloads.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t access alert details, blocking critical fleet management tasks and reducing system reliability.
findings.suggestion: Fix server-side or client-side loading issues to ensure consistent content rendering.

findings.user_goal: View vehicle details in the bottom drawer on mobile
findings.problem: The index.html vehicle list drawer in mobile view has horizontal overflow, cutting off vehicle details (e.g., plate numbers, locations).
findings.evidence: Visible text shows cut-off content (e.g., 'NY-09NX2 Freightliner Casca'), confirming horizontal overflow.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t view full vehicle details, reducing efficiency and clarity.
findings.suggestion: Implement responsive drawer design (e.g., horizontal scrolling, text wrapping) to fit mobile viewports.

findings.problem: Search inputs in alerts.html (e.g., 'Search alerts…', 'Search by plate / driver…') lack visible labels, relying only on placeholders, which is less accessible.
findings.evidence: DOM summary shows input fields with placeholders but no visible labels, and layout warnings confirm missing input labels.
findings.why_it_matters: Screen reader users may struggle to identify search purposes, and visual users may miss context.
findings.suggestion: Add visible labels (e.g., 'Search alerts', 'Search vehicles') above search inputs.

findings.user_goal: Explore all interactive features (e.g., navigation links, buttons) across pages
findings.problem: Only 0% of visible interactive feature signatures were directly exercised, indicating many controls (e.g., navigation links, alert actions) remain untested and may have usability issues.
findings.evidence: Coverage gaps confirm 0% of interactive features were exercised, with many untested controls (e.g., 'Assign', 'Details' buttons in alerts.html).
findings.why_it_matters: Untested controls may have hidden usability or accessibility issues, reducing confidence in the system’s UX.
findings.suggestion: Systematically test all interactive features (e.g., navigation links, buttons, form interactions) to identify and fix issues.
